pageSubtitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account using an authenticator app.
adminRequiredNotice: Your administrator requires you to set up two-factor authentication for this account.
setupInstructions: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or Authy.
manualEntryLabel: Can't scan the code? Enter this key manually:
confirmCodeLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from your app to confirm setup
emailVerifyInstructions: That code proves the app is working, but not that it's really you. We've sent a one-time code to {maskedEmail} — check your inbox and enter it below to finish.
emailCodeLabel: Enter the code sent to your email
emailCodeResent: A new code has been sent to your email.
recoveryCodesWarning: Store these codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
disableWarning: This removes the extra security layer from your account.
codeOrRecoveryCodeLabel: Enter a code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes
resetWarning: This disables your current authenticator and starts a new setup. Your existing recovery codes will stop working.
resetSetupNotice: Your authenticator was reset. Scan the new QR code below and keep the key somewhere safe, then sign in again to finish enabling it.
regenerateWarning: Your existing recovery codes will stop working once you generate new ones.
confirmCodeOnlyLabel: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm
signInAgainNotice: Your two-factor authentication settings were updated. For security, you need to sign in again to continue.
scanToInstallLabel: Scan with your phone to install
manualDescription: Follow these steps to set up two-factor authentication on your account.
manualStep1Description: Install Google Authenticator (or Microsoft Authenticator / Authy) on your phone.
manualStep2Description: Open the app and tap the "+" (Add) button.
manualStep3Description: Click "Enable Two-Factor Authentication" to get your QR code, then scan it with the app.
manualStep4Description: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows you to confirm setup.
manualStep5Description: From now on, you'll be asked for a code from the app when you log in.
howItWorks1: Log in with your username and password
howItWorks2: Open the authenticator app on your phone
howItWorks3: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app
howItWorks4: You're in — secure access to your account
tip1: Never share your QR code, setup key, or verification codes with anyone.
tip2: Don't take screenshots of your QR code or setup key.
tip3: Save your recovery codes somewhere safe when you enable this.
tip4: If you lose your phone, use a recovery code to sign in.

errors.invalidCode: Invalid or expired code. Please try again.
errors.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.setupNotStarted: Authenticator setup has not been started.
errors.emailNotOnFile: Your account has no email address on file. Contact an administrator to add one before setting up two-factor authentication.
